# Buildocrat — buildocrat.store

> Buildocrat (Buildocrat Property Technologies Ltd, CAC RC 7019619, Abuja) sells, stockpiles, sources and lists building materials for every Nigerian state. Prices are Buildocrat selling prices built from the weekly Nigeria Construction Rate Book (https://rates.buildocrat.store), Abuja base adjusted by state. Every order, offer, listing and request is finished in a WhatsApp chat on +234 701 802 4292; payment is only to a Buildocrat company account.

Prices updated: 2026-10-24. 777 material lines.

## Services
- [Buy](https://buildocrat.store/buy/): cart of materials, sent to WhatsApp for confirmation and invoice.
- [Stockpile](https://buildocrat.store/stockpile/): bundle offers (pay in full discount or 3/6-month plans, held for call-off) and Price Lock (fix prices 3–12 months; activation deposit; zero fees, spread only).
- [Sell](https://buildocrat.store/sell/): manufacturers, dealers, quarries and individuals list materials.
- [Source](https://buildocrat.store/source/): send a list or BoQ for quotes, including imported and bulk items.
- [Risk control](https://buildocrat.store/risk-control/): estimate material price exposure and request a risk plan.
- [All materials](https://buildocrat.store/materials/)
- [How it works & FAQ](https://buildocrat.store/help/)
